title: ECDSA sign/verify serialized: single global fd + mutex blocks all concurrent operations
description: All ECDSA sign and verify operations share g_crypto2dev_fd under g_ecdsa_fd_lock. In a TLS server where many connections do ECDSA at handshake time, all sign/verify operations queue behind this one mutex. The device might support concurrent ioctls on separate fds (like the operation fd pool for cipher/hash). Expected impact: measurable throughput reduction on a TLS server with high handshake rate (e.g., 100+ TLS connections/sec all doing ECDSA-256 sign). Fix direction: add ECDSA to the fd pool (open a pool fd, issue the sign ioctl on it, release it). Requires verifying the device supports DO_SIGN on non-global fds.
